shots.name: Shooter Lane
shots.notes: The skill shot happens on the display before you launch. Once it resolves, the game prompts you to press the launch button.

shots.name: Left Outer Orbit
shots.notes: Feeds the pop bumpers. Each shot up here also raises the bumper value by 500 points.

shots.name: Left Inner Orbit
shots.notes: Runs around the file cabinet and feeds the opposite flipper. A right flipper shot here comes back to the left flipper for an immediate return combo.

shots.name: Right Inner Orbit
shots.notes: Mirror of the left inner orbit. On a fast or badly levelled machine these can spit the ball straight down the middle, so watch the return.

shots.name: Right Outer Orbit
shots.notes: Also feeds the bumpers and raises their value. Both outer orbits only run all the way round on a strong, clean shot.

shots.name: Left Ramp
shots.notes: Narrow. Scores the first two jackpots in multiball and is the route to the extra ball. A short shot drops back out to the inner orbits rather than draining.

shots.name: Right Ramp
shots.notes: Spells F-B-I towards starting an episode, collects the double jackpot, and holds the lit extra ball. It can be backhanded with the timing right.

shots.name: Ramp Diverter
shots.notes: A pop-up diverter on the right side that decides which flipper the left ramp returns to. In multiball it hands you the ramp back for a second immediate jackpot.

shots.name: File Cabinet
shots.notes: A movable three-drawer cabinet in the middle of the playfield. Green light on top means it is ready for multiball; red means Super Jackpot is lit.

shots.name: Cabinet Magnet
shots.notes: Sits in front of the cabinet. Off-centre shots get flung sideways — sometimes straight back into the cabinet for free hits. It stays energised throughout THE TRUTH.

shots.name: Trapdoor Scoop
shots.notes: Hidden under a trapdoor that opens once F-B-I is spelled. This is where episodes start, and it is a scoring shot inside Syzygy and Terma.

shots.name: Left Red Targets
shots.notes: Three standups. Completing a bank raises either the TRUTH jackpot or the multiball jackpot by 50K.

shots.name: Right Red Targets
shots.notes: The matching bank on the right. If one bank has already been used to raise the TRUTH value, the other raises the multiball jackpot.

shots.name: Pop Bumpers
shots.notes: Three of them, and unusually lively. They start at 1.5K and climb 500 a time from outer orbit shots.

shots.name: E-B-E Rollover Lanes
shots.notes: Three lanes above the bumpers with flipper lane change. Completing them steps the bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Carries a yellow circle with a black X that lights when you complete the opening skill shot.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Matching inlane on the right.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: No kickback. A roughly five-second ball save covers the start of each ball, with no grace period on it.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: Same on the right.

shots.name: Centre Post
shots.notes: A small post below and between the flippers. It saves a fair number of centre drains on a game this bouncy.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Chooses Scully in the opening skill shot, and rotates the E-B-E lanes.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Chooses Mulder in the opening skill shot. Held in while you press start, it turns off the ball-three multiball gift.

goals.title: Choose Your Agent
goals.summary: Before you launch, two faces alternate on the display with a box flashing around each in turn. Press the matching flipper at the right moment: right for Mulder, left for Scully. Get it right and you are offered a second pick.
goals.reward: Lights the inlane X and sets your bonus type
instructions: Before you launch, two faces alternate on the display with a box flashing around each in turn.
Press the RIGHT flipper button at the right moment to lock in Mulder, or wait for the second pick and take Scully with the LEFT flipper.
Your agent choice shapes the awards the game leans toward — make it deliberately, not by letting the timer decide.

goals.title: Light The Big X
goals.summary: Five shots fill the large X insert in the lower playfield and start THE TRUTH. The chain is fixed: an inner orbit lights the outer orbit on the same side, that outer orbit lights the ramp on that side, and once both ramps are flashing either one starts the mode.

steps.detail: The two inner orbits are lit first. Every X shot pays 50K whether it is lit or not.

steps.action: Take the outer orbit on the same side
steps.detail: That sets the ramp X on that side flashing.
When both ramp Xs are flashing, either ramp completes the X and starts the mode.

goals.title: THE TRUTH
goals.summary: A four-ball multiball and the deepest thing on the machine. Shoot each ramp and each orbit once for a TRUTH jackpot worth 200K base, then hit the file cabinet three times to arm the Super Jackpot, then shoot the cabinet again to collect it.
goals.reward: 200K+ per shot, then a Super Jackpot

steps.detail: Each of the six main shots pays a jackpot once, and every completed red target bank has already added 50K to that base.
The three red triangles in front of the cabinet light from the bottom up as you do.
The cabinet rides up and down at this point, so the shot has to be timed as well as aimed.

goals.title: Park Balls On The Magnet
goals.summary: During THE TRUTH the magnet in front of the cabinet stays energised. Anything but a hard, dead-centre shot gets caught and held — and with two balls parked there you effectively get a calm two-ball game to clear the ramps and orbits.

steps.detail: Balls that are not hit hard enough to beat the magnet get grabbed and held near the cabinet.

steps.action: Work the mode with what is left
steps.detail: Lose the free balls and, a few seconds later, the magnet drops what it is holding — the mode carries on regardless, so nothing is wasted.

goals.title: Spell F-B-I And Start An Episode
goals.summary: Every right ramp shot spots a letter of F-B-I, and the letters are already spotted for you at the start of a game. Complete them and a trapdoor drops open to reveal a scoop — shoot it to start one of eight episodes.
goals.reward: 100K for starting, plus the episode itself

steps.detail: A solid light means the letter is still needed; flashing means it is already spotted.
Nothing on the playfield records which episodes you have played, so keep track yourself.

goals.title: The Four-Shot Episodes
goals.summary: Colony, Smoking Man and Talitha Cumi are all four-shot rounds worth 1.4M for a completion, and they are the most reliable points on the machine. Values climb 250K, 300K, 350K, 400K as you go.

steps.action: Smoking Man: all four orbits in 15 seconds
steps.detail: Fifteen seconds is tight, so start at whichever orbit your first shot can reach cleanly.
Each lit left orbit you hit lights its partner on the right; collect those next. The left side never goes dark while the round runs.

steps.action: Talitha Cumi: both outer orbits and both ramps
steps.detail: Thirty seconds, four shots, and the alien stiletto is always behind the last one you break.

goals.title: Syzygy
goals.summary: The biggest scoring episode in the game and the one to milk. It starts as a two-ball round and alternates: left ramp for 100K, trapdoor for 200K, ramp for 300K, trapdoor for 400K, climbing with no ceiling — and each successful shot adds another ball, up to four.

steps.detail: Every alternation raises the next value by another 100K.
A ball is added for each shot made, as long as the second-to-last ball has not reached the trough.
The round ends the moment you fall back to one ball, so protecting the extra balls is the whole game here.

goals.title: The Countdown Episodes
goals.summary: Herenvolk and Terma both open with a value that sits at 420K for a beat and then drops fast. Collect it before it bottoms out or the episode is simply over — these are the two rounds where hesitating costs you everything.

steps.action: Herenvolk: grab the countdown on the left ramp
steps.detail: Then collect it on the right ramp and keep alternating for the twenty seconds that follow.

steps.action: Terma: grab it in the trapdoor
steps.detail: The countdown starts the moment the round does, so the trapdoor shot has to be your first thought.
Twenty seconds to take both ramps and all four orbits for the trapdoor value on each.

goals.title: The Ramp Episodes
goals.summary: Hambug and The Host are short timed rounds that only ask for flashing ramps. Hambug runs 30 seconds and pays 250K on the first ramp with 50K added to each shot after it; The Host gives you 20 seconds of the same idea.

steps.detail: The ramps here are narrow and unforgiving of a shot that is even slightly off line.
A short ramp shot falls back out to the inner orbits instead of coming back at you, so a miss is rarely fatal.

goals.title: Open The File Cabinet
goals.summary: Hit the file cabinet enough times — five by default — and it sinks two drawers, exposing the top one. Shoot the ball into it to start a three-ball multiball. Each subsequent multiball needs one more cabinet hit than the last.

steps.detail: The magnet will sometimes throw a rejected ball straight back into it, giving you free progress.
Green on top of the cabinet means it is ready; the magnet may then feed the ball right in for you.
Two balls are auto-launched and the rest arrive at the right flipper. On a standard setup the game spots multiball-ready by ball three if you have not got there yourself.

goals.title: The Jackpot Sequence
goals.summary: Multiball scoring runs on rails once you know it: left ramp for jackpot one, left ramp again for jackpot two, right ramp for the double, cabinet for the super — then it loops back to the start.
goals.reward: 500K base, doubled, then at least doubled again

steps.action: Two jackpots off the left ramp
steps.detail: The diverter feeds the first jackpot straight back to the same flipper, so the second one is a repeat shot.
After the second jackpot the ball is handed to the left flipper for exactly this shot.
The double and super are both timed. Miss the double and you must score a jackpot again to relight it; miss the super and one jackpot usually brings it back.

goals.title: Raise The Jackpot First
goals.summary: The 500K base jackpot is not fixed. Sweep the red target banks before you open the cabinet, keep hitting the cabinet during multiball, and let the ball rattle in the bumpers — all three raise what every jackpot pays.
goals.reward: +50K per target bank, +25K per cabinet hit

steps.detail: Worth 50K on the base. If one bank has already gone to the TRUTH value, the other one feeds the multiball jackpot.
Do this before multiball starts, not during it.
Every bumper hit nudges the jackpot value up as well.

goals.title: The Multiball Restart
goals.summary: A rule that saves ruined multiballs. If you drop back to a single ball without having collected any jackpot at all, you get roughly fifteen seconds to shoot the file cabinet and start the whole thing over. It is offered once per multiball.

steps.action: Go straight back to the cabinet
steps.detail: Fifteen seconds is not long on a game this bouncy, so do not stop to trap up.

steps.action: Know when it is not offered
steps.detail: Collect even one jackpot and the restart is gone — there is also no grace period for balls lost at the very start of multiball.

goals.title: The Mini-Loop Award
goals.summary: The inner orbits are laid out so a left flipper shot returns to the right flipper and vice versa. Chain them and you collect the mini-loop award — 250K the first time, 500K the second, with the required loop count climbing after each.

steps.detail: You do not need to complete the whole orbit — tripping the switch counts.

steps.action: Come straight back the other way
steps.detail: Beware of a fast or unlevel machine: a quick ball through the inner orbit can come out down the middle instead of onto the far flipper.

goals.title: E-B-E And The Bonus Multiplier
goals.summary: The three lanes above the bumpers step your bonus through 2x, 3x, 4x, 6x and a maximum of 8x, with flipper lane change to make it easy. There is no bonus hold in this game — the multiplier drops back to 1x every ball.
goals.reward: Up to 8x bonus, plus a lit extra ball

steps.action: Rotate the lanes with the flippers
steps.detail: The yellow triangles above the flippers show which multipliers you have taken.
Balls kicked back up through the lanes complete them for free. An extra ball lights on the way up the ladder.

goals.title: Super Pops
goals.summary: The bumpers open at 1.5K and every outer orbit shot adds 500 to that. Rack up enough hits — around sixty by default — and Super Pops turns each one into 20K. It resets at the start of every ball, so use it while you have it.

steps.action: Feed the bumpers with the outer orbits
steps.detail: Both outer orbits deliver the ball into the bumper nest and raise its value on the way.
The bumpers are lively enough that a bit of nudging gets you there quickly.

goals.title: The Extra Ball
goals.summary: Four left ramp shots — the default — light the extra ball at the right ramp, and it stays lit from ball to ball until you take it. On most setups this is available only once in a game, so it is worth going out of your way for early.

steps.detail: They do not need to be consecutive.
Backhanding this ramp is possible with good timing and a healthy flipper, which makes it much safer to collect.

goals.title: The Pre-Game Flipper Hold
goals.summary: Hold the right flipper in while you press start and the game stops handing you an easy multiball later — every multiball then requires the full default number of file cabinet hits rather than being spotted for you on ball three.

steps.action: Hold it as you press start
steps.detail: Nothing on the display makes a fuss about it.
Worth choosing if you are practising, and worth avoiding if you just want the balls in play.

achievements.title: Both Agents
achievements.desc: Pick Mulder and Scully correctly on the opening skill shot.

achievements.title: Case File Opened
achievements.desc: Spell F-B-I and start an episode in the trapdoor scoop.

achievements.title: Case Closed
achievements.desc: Complete any of the four-shot episodes for its 1.4M finish.

achievements.title: Syzygy
achievements.desc: Climb the Syzygy ladder past four alternating shots.

achievements.title: Open The Drawer
achievements.desc: Hit the file cabinet enough times to start multiball.

achievements.title: Super Jackpot
achievements.desc: Run the ramp sequence and collect the multiball Super Jackpot.

achievements.title: The Truth
achievements.desc: Complete the big X and start THE TRUTH four-ball multiball.

achievements.title: Trust No One
achievements.desc: Arm and collect the Super Jackpot inside THE TRUTH.

achievements.title: Loop Specialist
achievements.desc: Chain the inner orbits for a mini-loop award.

achievements.title: Extra Ball
achievements.desc: Light the extra ball on the left ramp and collect it on the right.

drills.title: Pick Your Agent On Purpose
drills.text: Before you launch, watch the box flash around the two faces and press the matching flipper deliberately — right for Mulder, left for Scully — rather than letting the timer choose for you. Land the first pick and the game offers you a second one, so this is a habit worth having before the ball is even in play.

drills.title: Four Left Ramps
drills.text: This ramp is narrow and punishes a shot that is only slightly off line, but a short one falls back out to the inner orbits instead of draining, so you can afford to keep swinging. Bank four of them, then go collect on the right ramp — practise the backhand there, since it is the safer way to take it.

drills.title: Run The X Down One Side
drills.text: Pick a side and run it in order: inner orbit, then the outer orbit on that same side, then the ramp it lights. Do the mirror on the other side and either flashing ramp finishes the X, so the drill is the sequence, not any single shot in it.

drills.title: Jackpots On Rails
drills.text: Left ramp, left ramp again off the diverter feed, right ramp for the double, cabinet for the super — run the same four shots in the same order every multiball. The diverter hands the first jackpot back to the flipper you shot from, so the repeat is set up for you if you are expecting it.

drills.title: Park Balls On The Magnet
drills.text: During THE TRUTH the magnet in front of the cabinet stays live, so feed it shots that are not hard and dead centre and let it grab them. Two balls held there turns a four-ball scramble into a calm two-ball game while you clear the ramps and orbits.

drills.title: Sweep The Red Banks First
drills.text: Clear both red target banks and spend time in the bumpers before you ever open the cabinet, because all of that raises what every jackpot will pay. Doing it during multiball instead is the standard way players end up cashing a small jackpot.
drills.reps: both banks cleared before every multiball, 5 games

actionButton.how: Nothing extra to press here. A launch button puts the ball in play when the display tells you to, and after that it does nothing at all — the rest of the game is flippers, nudging, and the file cabinet.

howItPlays.objective: X-Files is a Sega machine about Mulder and Scully chasing the paranormal. Light the big X to open THE TRUTH, spell F-B-I to start episodes at the trapdoor, and crack the file cabinet for multiball.
loop: Pick your agent on the display before launch -- right flipper for Mulder, left for Scully -- to light the inlane X and set your bonus for the ball.
Build the big X in a fixed order: take an inner orbit, then the outer orbit beside it, then the ramp above; do both sides until the two ramps flash, and either one opens THE TRUTH.
Spell F-B-I at the right ramp to spring the trapdoor, then shoot the revealed scoop to start an episode -- the four-shot rounds are the steadiest points here.
Bash the file cabinet until it opens for a three-ball multiball, and run the jackpots on rails from the ramps to the cabinet super.
Sweep the red target banks and stir up the bumpers before opening the cabinet so every jackpot pays more, and cycle the E-B-E lanes with the flippers to lift your bonus multiplier.

lights.name: The Big X
lights.lit: The X inserts light in a set chain -- the two inner orbits first, each lighting the outer orbit at its shoulder, and each outer orbit lighting the ramp on its side; every one of these shots scores even when its X is dark.
lights.flashing: Both ramp arrows flashing means the mode is one ramp away.
lights.then: Fill the X with five shots and either flashing ramp opens THE TRUTH, the four-ball centerpiece of the machine.

lights.name: F-B-I and the Trapdoor
lights.lit: Every right ramp spots a letter of F-B-I -- a steady letter is still owed, a flashing one is already spotted -- and they come pre-spotted as a game begins.
lights.then: Complete F-B-I to spring open the trapdoor, exposing a scoop -- shoot it to launch one of the episodes, from the reliable four-shot rounds to the uncapped ladder of Syzygy and the fast countdowns of Terma and Herenvolk.

lights.name: File Cabinet
lights.lit: A green light atop the cabinet means it is ready for multiball; a red one means the Super Jackpot is lit. The magnet out front will sometimes fling a rejected ball right back in for free progress.
lights.then: Bash the cabinet until its drawers drop away, then shoot the open drawer to start a three-ball multiball; each later one demands another cabinet hit before it will open.

lights.name: Red Target Banks
lights.lit: A lit red standup is one still up in its bank; clearing a whole bank raises either the TRUTH value or the multiball jackpot, and every outer-orbit feed into the bumpers climbs their worth too.
lights.then: Clear both banks and spend time in the lively bumpers before you ever open the cabinet, so the jackpots you collect are already fat -- leaving it until multiball is how players end up cashing small.

lights.name: E-B-E Lanes
lights.lit: A lit E-B-E lane above the bumpers is one you have not rolled yet; complete all three to step your bonus multiplier up its ladder, and an extra ball lights somewhere along the climb.

control.effect: a tap of a flipper button rotates which of the three E-B-E lanes are lit, so you can slide an unlit lane under the ball as it drops out of the bumpers
control.when: before the ball rolls through the lanes

lights.then: Line the lit lanes up with a flip and complete the set to climb toward an eightfold bonus and to light the extra ball. There is no bonus hold, so the multiplier falls back to single every ball -- it is a habit to rebuild, not a bank.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: A tap of either flipper button rotates which of the three E-B-E lanes are lit, so slide an unlit one under the ball as it comes down off the bumpers. Complete all three to raise your bonus multiplier toward its eightfold top and to light an extra ball -- but the multiplier drops back to single as each new ball starts, so it is progress you rebuild rather than keep.

scoring.text: Choose your agent on the plunge, then begin building the X -- inner orbit, the outer orbit beside it, then the ramp -- while spotting F-B-I on the right ramp for a first episode. Bank four left ramps to light the extra ball, since it stays lit until you take it and is usually a once-a-game gift.

Milk the episodes for steady points -- the four-shot rounds pay well, and Syzygy climbs with no ceiling as long as you shield its extra balls. Chain the inner orbits flipper to flipper for the mini-loop award, and cycle the E-B-E lanes for your bonus multiplier.

Fill the X and start THE TRUTH, a four-ball multiball where the front magnet stays live -- feed it soft shots to park a ball or two and turn the scramble into a calm hunt for the ramp and orbit jackpots, then the cabinet Super. Raise the banks and bumpers beforehand so the whole mode pays at its ceiling.
